exposure: Mode of delivery (spontaneous vaginal delivery without episiotomy, spontaneous vaginal delivery with episiotomy, cesarean section)
Women with Regular Female Sexual Function (RFSF)
finding: While the study did not find a direct correlation between mode of delivery and the onset of female postpartum sexual dysfunction, women with FSD who underwent episiotomy had significantly lower FSFI scores.
mod_finding: Women who had vaginal delivery with episiotomy had higher FSFI scores in the RFSF group but lower FSFI scores in the FSD group compared to other delivery modes.
